title: Agents and marketplaces now gate discovery; our store must be agent-ready
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); 34% would use GenAI for gift ideas (Gartner). Walmart opened to outside AI agents; PC shipments fell 21% in Q3 (Counterpoint); Apple raised iPad mini pricing on memory costs.

points.headline: AI agents are becoming a buying channel, and retailers are setting the rules
points.detail: Walmart opened to outside agents with profiles, terms and spending limits while Amazon blocks them. We should decide how agents read and buy from our store.

points.headline: Shoppers already start with AI, and may send agents to marketplaces first
points.detail: NIQ finds 55% use AI in discovery; Gartner says 34% would use GenAI for gifts. Our product data and listings need to be readable by AI tools and agents.

points.headline: A shrinking PC market meets rising memory costs, squeezing price and margin
points.detail: Counterpoint sees Q3 shipments down 21%; Apple lifted iPad mini pricing on memory costs and PC makers are shifting production to China. We should plan Q4 pricing and inventory carefully.

points.headline: Holiday demand is growing online, with Walmart stretching its sales events
points.detail: Adobe forecasts $275.1B in US online holiday sales (+6.7%) and Walmart extends Black Friday and Cyber Monday to 14 days. We should prepare Cyber 5 deal depth and inventory.
